candidates.title: Uber S3 breach via an AWS key in a private GitHub repository

discovery.usageRights: Citation and short paraphrase only; check publisher terms before reuse.

candidates.dedupeCheck: Same victim as incident:uber-powershell-pam-credentials-2022 but a separate event.

claims.statement: Between October 13 and November 15, 2016, intruders accessed Uber's Amazon S3 datastore using an AWS access key posted to a private GitHub repository.
The FTC says intruders reached the repository using passwords exposed in other breaches; Uber did not require multi-factor authentication for GitHub access.

unresolvedQuestions: CWE-798 is a weakness candidate only.

discovery.usageRights: Citation and short paraphrase only; check publisher terms before reuse.
Citation and short paraphrase only; check publisher terms before reuse.

candidates.dedupeCheck: Related npm-ecosystem campaign to incident:cisa-shai-hulud-2025, but a distinct compromise.

claims.statement: Malicious Nx versions published to npm on August 26, 2025 ran a post-install script that harvested GitHub and npm tokens, SSH keys, and other secrets.
The script invoked installed AI CLI tools with permission-skipping flags to search the filesystem for sensitive files.
Wiz observed over a thousand valid GitHub tokens and dozens of valid cloud credentials among the leaked data.

attackMappings.rationale: Reported compromise of a widely used development package (Nx) distributed through npm.

unresolvedQuestions: Primary maintainer advisory (Nx GitHub security advisory) should be added.

Related to incident:cisa-shai-hulud-2025 by ecosystem only; relationship not reviewed.
